people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

translations.web: It will be, when you have finished reading this book, that you shall bind a stone to it, and cast it into the middle of the Euphrates.
translations.bsb: When you finish reading this scroll, tie a stone to it and cast it into the Euphrates.
translations.kjv: And it shall be, when thou hast made an end of reading this book, that thou shalt bind a stone to it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates:
